title: Add projection and alias root CAS through Kit

scope.assurance_scope: PCSM Python-v1 projection-root and alias-root CAS capability assessment for the exact current admitted source forest
scope.implementation_delta: Reuse the current KitProofContextStateStore@0.1 byte/CID CAS boundary and reject it as a complete projection/alias-root equivalent: it stores arbitrary immutable bytes under verified CIDv1-base32 identities, but exposes neither a versioned ProjectionRoot nor AliasRoot record, typed root/reference relations, an alias namespace, an atomic compare-and-swap head, or a retrieval/admission path for such roots. IncrementalSealStore@0.1 and KitVerificationStore@0.1 add limited caller-supplied parent/generation checks, respectively, but neither persists or compares a named projection/alias root. The exact-output authority permits only this receipt, so no source or test mutation is made and no competing authority is created.
scope.non_promotion_reason: No current-head Kit package supplies the named versioned CAS contract or package-specific positive/negative tests. The prescribed sealed validation cannot load the existing proof-context suite because its mandatory tests conftest imports aiohttp and aiohttp_available=False. The generic byte-CAS implementation and its unexecuted generic tests are not promoted to a projection/alias-root implementation, a passing validation result, an exact-PCSM source-forest instance, or a formal proof.

freshness_check.method: Recorded outer HEAD and HEAD^{tree}; compared each admitted gitlink commit/tree with its checked-out nested HEAD and HEAD^{tree}; inspected outer and Kit porcelain before receipt creation; calculated the scheduler and selected Kit source/test Git blobs and SHA-256 digests; inspected all current proof_context provider modules and their focused tests; searched the exact Kit proof_context roots and PCSM supervisor implementation/test roots for a versioned projection-root/alias-root CAS contract; and ran the required suite under the prescribed sealed PATH with fresh private HOME/XDG roots.
freshness_check.result: The dispatch commit equals outer HEAD and the selected Kit commit/tree equals its checked-out head. The inspected worktrees were clean before the declared receipt write. KitProofContextStateStore@0.1 is current and verifies byte-to-CID agreement, but the inspected roots contain no ProjectionRoot, AliasRoot, projection_root, alias_root, ProjectionAlias, or typed root-CAS contract. The required suite failed before collection solely because the sealed test conftest imports unavailable aiohttp; it did not execute any test, so no passing or failing semantic assertion is claimed.
freshness_check.invalidates_on: Any change to a bound outer commit/tree, admitted gitlink/head/tree, scheduler digest, listed source/test digest, version/schema/identity behavior, root-CAS implementation, aiohttp availability, PCSM source-map capability, or validation result requires a fresh receipt.

pcsm_source_map.reason: No current-tree aggregate PCSM SourceLinkReceipt or canonical PCSM source-map CID resolves exact PCSM file/node/span identities to a projection root or alias root. Repository trees, Git blobs, SHA-256 digests, arbitrary Kit object CIDs, and generic fixture roots are freshness or generic-storage evidence only and are not relabelled as this missing PCSM contract.

selected_existing_authority.minimum_delta_reason: KitProofContextStateStore@0.1 is the smallest existing Kit authority for immutable byte storage with CIDv1 verification. Its contract is deliberately generic. A PCSM wrapper, alias dictionary, root table, named head, or compare-and-swap layer cannot be truthfully inferred from that API and would be a new authority; the exact receipt-only dispatch cannot add it.

components.role: Current Kit byte storage facade. It requires an explicit local root, delegates immutable byte writes to HermeticProofSealStore, and exposes put/get/cid_for with CIDv1-base32 verification.
components.equivalence_limit: It has no projection-root/alias-root record schema, alias-to-canonical binding, named root lookup, compare-and-swap operation, generation/head state, root graph traversal, or PCSM source-map binding.

components.role: Generic checkpoint/delta-seal byte writer with a caller-supplied expected_parent_cid equality guard and simulated-provenance rejection.
components.equivalence_limit: The parent relationship is not persisted in the stored payload by this API and no named projection or alias root is loaded or atomically updated, so it is not root CAS.

components.role: Generic proof-receipt byte writer with simulated-provenance rejection and a caller-supplied generation consistency check.
components.equivalence_limit: It does not retain a root head or atomically compare it against an expected projection/alias root, so its generation check is not a projection/alias-root CAS implementation.

determinism_and_binding.generic_storage: artifacts.cid_for_bytes derives the Kit content CID and rejects a non-base32 result; put_bytes rejects a claimed CID unequal to bytes and get_bytes recomputes the CID after verified retrieval. Identical byte writes are intended to deduplicate in the hermetic immutable store.
determinism_and_binding.available_binding: The selected generic contract binds stored bytes to an ArtifactReference CID. The public namespace pins proof_context=0.1 and proof_seal_store=1.0.0 compatibility metadata.
determinism_and_binding.missing_binding: No versioned projection/alias root payload has schema fields for canonical projection CID, alias CID/name/namespace, alias-target relation, exact repository/tree/source-map CID, expected root, resulting root, or an atomic linearization boundary. No arbitrary byte CID is treated as any of those semantic bindings.
determinism_and_binding.authority_boundary: Kit byte persistence establishes exact-byte identity only. It does not judge semantic soundness, select canonical identity, authorize aliasing, mutate source, authorize M2/M3 work, admit a projection, or make a completion/promotion decision. Aliases, if later implemented, must never replace canonical identity.

positive_coverage_present_but_unexecuted: Generic byte writes return CIDv1-base32 references whose verified reads recover the original bytes.

generic_test_inventory.scope_limit: The inventory is source inspection, not test execution. It does not make a generic fixture a measured PCSM source-forest run or a package-specific root-CAS validation.

capability_disposition.unavailable_capability: A current-head versioned and schema-bound Kit implementation that models a canonical projection root and a separate alias root, binds each to the exact PCSM repository/tree/source-map, preserves alias non-canonicality, and atomically updates/retrieves them through an expected-root CAS API with direct sealed positive and negative validation.

limitations: This exact-output dispatch is receipt-only. It does not modify Kit implementation/tests, install aiohttp, create root schemas, add a named-root store, or alter protected planning/configuration files.
KitProofContextStateStore@0.1 verifies bytes and CIDs but accepts untyped arbitrary payloads. It cannot supply the missing root/alias semantic constraints by convention.

IncrementalSealStore@0.1 compares caller arguments before an immutable write; KitVerificationStore@0.1 checks supplied generations. Neither establishes durable named-root state or an atomic expected-root update.
The sealed required suite stops at conftest import due to missing aiohttp; its 37 test definitions are unavailable rather than passing or failing execution evidence.
No current aggregate PCSM SourceLinkReceipt/source-map CID binds an exact source forest to a projection or alias root, and no generic Git/tree/digest identity is relabelled as that CID.

No watcher event, model output, arbitrary artifact CID, test definition, receipt, or generic fixture is treated as semantic authority, source mutation, M2/M3 mutation, completion authority, or promotion evidence.
This receipt has no immutable self-CID because adding one would change its bytes.
